question: Who has been selected as the 193rd member of the UN?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South Sudan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **South Sudan** became the 193rd member of the United Nations.
 
• South Sudan gained independence from Sudan on **9th July 2011** after a referendum.
 
• The country was admitted to the United Nations on **14th July 2011**.
 
• South Sudan's admission marked the first addition to the UN membership since Montenegro in 2006.
 
• The admission of South Sudan was approved by the UN General Assembly through a resolution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The United Nations was established on **24th October 1945**, after World War II, to promote peace and cooperation among countries.
 
• The UN initially had **51 member states** and has grown to include almost all sovereign states in the world.
 
• The UN works on a wide range of global issues, including peace and security, climate change, sustainable development, human rights, disarmament, terrorism, humanitarian and health emergencies, gender equality, governance, and food production.
 
• The **General Assembly** is one of the six main organs of the UN, where all member states have equal representation.
 
• Membership in the UN is open to all peace-loving states that accept the obligations contained in the UN Charter and, in the judgment of the Organization, are able and willing to carry out these obligations.
